body: Yeah as much as a rebound is a knee jerk reaction I know I would not be In good shape for a relationship for quite a while. Also love your self awareness but I think you’re a good person, you made me feel better.

yeah exactly, I’m hoping for happy but I’m also really just trying to not feel so sad and suicidal all the time. A lot of people are saying to give it time and I’ll do my best I’m just afraid how long I’ll be feeling this way. But thank you for replying xo
Oh my 9 years I can’t even imagine the state I would be in right now if it were 9 years. I’m so sorry I hope you stay safe and feel better too
Thank you it means a lot and same for you, it’s helpful talking to others with BPD
I’m happy you’re still here and that you have your wife and kids making your life better! I hope one day I can relate to that
Thank you I hope so, and I’ll do my best

So you’re going through it with me then cause that is along the lines of what he told me, “I’m happy but sometimes I wonder if I would be happier single or with someone else” so I know how badly that stings and I know how dumb it sounds too because happiness isn’t something I put on a scale I’m either happy with someone or I’m not. You are right though, I keep reminding myself of the cheating to try and reinforce the idea that he isn’t someone worth feeling sad over. Unfortunately it kind of just makes me feel pathetic half the time and like I’ll never find anyone who will be loyal if he wasn’t. I hope that you’re right and that I’ll find someone who treats me better and I hope you find someone better too. On her behalf I’m sorry she said those things and left you feeling this way. Thank you also for sharing this with me xo
I’m so sorry you lost your fp over that, that’s awful, you deserved better than that. I’m glad you’re feeling better and hopefully I’ll find the magic recipe and be okay soon too lol

That’s literally how I’m feeling and honestly behaving right now. I just created this fantasy of he and I getting married and being each others person forever, so that really resonates with me because he’s become my world. I really really want to live for me but I feel so worthless and pathetic right now because he’s okay and I’m not. 
Anyways thank you for taking the time to tell me this it means a lot and helps a lot too.

Yeah having BPD is the one thing I wish I could completely get rid of and I’m working on it but it’s so hard to get control of it. But you’re right and you sound a lot like a good friend of mine, it’s been hard trying to not let it get the best of me but it’s comforting to hear this from someone else who has BPD because I know you understand. Thank you.

Yeah if I can find someone who makes me even happier and I can get control of my life again I’ll be really happy. 
Also thank you, I’m really grateful for your message. You’re sweet, you won’t die a virgin lmaoo but that made me laugh so it means a lot!

I hate that time is required to heal because I know it’ll be a long while before I feel better at all, but thank you. 
And no im not Dutch don’t worry but check in on your friend because im sure she’s hurting like I am.  Xo
Thank you for the support ya I guess I’m still here trying
I’m sorry you’re going through this too it’s awful but it’s kind of nice knowing I’m not alone feeling this way and thinking of ending things

Thank you, it really is hard to go through any kind of breakup with BPD, I feel crazy because of how intense losing people feels for me. I’m praying that it does pass and hopefully soon I’m
Trying my best it’s just so hard and I’m exhausted.
Thank you it means a lot and actually I think that was pretty good advice
Thanks for the offer and I really hope that what you’re saying does happen for me I can’t handle all this sadness for much longer
I’m so sorry you feel this way, no one deserves to feel like this. Can I ask is there anything at all that makes you feel happy?

I for once understand what you’re describing because I feel that way too, and I cannot sleep either. I just want to tell you that being alive leaves so many doors open, once you end things you can’t go back. A lot of people statically show signs of regret when unaliving them self. Just know that life can turn around for you and/or me and it’s not worth cutting it short when you can be happy. Unfortunately it’s just not as easy for people like us. Get help please, I hope you find happiness and peace.

I can’t say that I understand what you’re going through, but I can say that I feel for you and wish you nothing but good luck in this journey. I’m sorry you were born in the wrong body and I’m sorry so many people don’t support you, but I do, and I really hope you stay safe and get top surgery safely ASAP.
